title: CinemaCodeStudioEditGrammar
description: Gate 1.5 Script Shape & Edit Grammar: extracts the script's unique narrative arc and generates a per-script shot vocabulary, camera-move sequence, transition vocabulary, and pacing signature. This is what makes every edit uniquely identifiable — never reuse the same grammar across two scripts.

scriptShape.description: The script's unique narrative arc — NOT the universal HOOK/SETUP/TENSION/EVIDENCE/PAYOFF/CTA skeleton. Describe the specific shape this script takes.

arcName.description: A human-readable name for this script's narrative shape (e.g., 'Contrarian Reveal', 'Teardown-Rebuild', 'Hero-Villain-Resolution').

beatSequence.description: Custom beat IDs for THIS script — NOT the fixed HOOK/SETUP/TENSION enum. Examples: 'INVERT_PREMISE', 'CRITICAL_FLAW', 'EXPERIMENT', 'BLOWUP', 'RECONSTRUCTION'.

beatDescriptions.description: Map of each beat ID to a one-line description of what happens in that beat.

shotVocabulary.description: The specific sequence of shot scales for THIS script. Must alternate — no three consecutive shots at the same scale.

cameraMoveVocabulary.description: Distinct camera moves for THIS script. Each must have a unique motivation tied to the script's beat.

transitionVocabulary.description: Distinct transition types for THIS script. No two consecutive transitions may share the same type.

pacingSignature.description: The rhythmic DNA of this edit — how fast/slow it starts, where it accelerates, where it breathes.

accelerationPoint.description: At which beat the cut rate increases (e.g., 'After the first counterexample at beat 3').

breathHoldLocation.description: Which beat gets the longest single-shot hold for emotional impact (e.g., 'The silent rebuild at the climax').

scriptSignatureHash.description: A deterministic hash or short phrase that uniquely identifies this edit's grammar. Must differ from any other script's signature. Example: 'INVERT-FLAW-SHADOW-REBUILD-0425'.

forbiddenRepetitions.description: Explicit patterns from the universal skeleton that this script must NOT repeat. Used to prevent 'same edit' leakage.

items.description: e.g., 'No three consecutive CU shots', 'No portal-zoom-out on every transition', 'No BokehRingWipe between every scene'.
